answer: Charge every new identity a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove fraud, so spawning fake agents costs real money instead of being free. Trust then grows like a reef: each verified job adds a small layer, and a newcomer with no history cannot outvote elders no matter how many copies it makes. Every stake and job is written to a public ledger solid as marble, so at dawn anyone can audit which identities earned standing and which were bought in bulk.
